newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline firm as market awakes after holidays.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline firm as market awakes after holidays.

text.p: NWE gasoline was firm on Monday amid close to nonexistent trade as the market got back into gear following the spate of public holidays across Europe last week, traders said.
Eurograde barge offers were talked in a range of $198-$199 a tonne fob ARA, but buyers were sidelined. A very small parcel of regular gasoline traded at $191.50 a tonne.
"There's not too much going on," said one trader. "For many German traders it's their first day in the office since last Wednesday. I don't expect to see too much activity until Tuesday."
"Hopefully now we've got the holidays out of the way we can get down to some trading," said one trader.
